name: 英嘉
src: 月银纪史诗/第八歌_未磨白骨.md:217
who: Inga, a dwarf woman of the first forge of the Smelting Heart, forty-six and in a dwarf's prime, looking like a human woman of about thirty: about 139 cm, short even among dwarves, with shoulders as wide as a door. Copper-red hair in two thick braids hanging to her waist, each end closed with a ring of carved stone. Round face with two faint old scars, one on each cheekbone. Amber eyes, the colour of firelight, that look first at what people hold in their hands. Both arms darkened by furnace heat up to the shoulders, thick knuckles, a callus across each palm; she grips everything with only a third of her strength. A calm, gentle, heavy air; she walks softly because she is afraid of cracking the floor.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf woman's face, a grown woman's face in the prime of life, round and broad, NOT a child's: amber eyes of medium size with a calm steady gaze under thick copper brows; a small broad nose; two short faint pale scars on the cheekbones, one on each side; a full closed mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 139 cm, short, broad and solid: massive shoulders, a very full bust, a thick waist and broad hips, a body like an ore block with roots.
palette: copper red and forge amber, soot grey, leather brown, bone white, a little stone grey
casual: Her smithy-city clothes: a coarse short-sleeved wool tunic of the forge city in undyed grey, a thick leather waistcoat over it, heavy wool trousers and iron-toed boots. At her belt on the right hand side a short white bone sword in a plain chiselled stone scabbard that has never been opened, and on the left hip a thick-walled stone bowl as sturdy as a wall. A gentle, steady look.
private: Off the forge: a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed wool shirt to mid-thigh over plain wool trousers, thick knitted socks and soft felt slippers, the braids hanging forward over the shoulders. She holds a small stone bowl of broth in both hands, a quiet closed-mouth smile.
battle: Fighting with her bare hands: the leather waistcoat tightened, thick leather bracers up to the elbows, heavy fingerless leather gloves, iron-toed boots planted wide. The white bone sword stays sheathed in its stone scabbard at her belt on the right hand side; both fists are raised in front of her chest, a steady, heavy, unafraid look, the brows low.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a wide braced wrestler's stance, the knees bent, both fists raised in front of the chest, the shoulders squared, the brows low and the mouth closed; she holds no weapon and the bone sword stays sheathed at her belt.
formal: At the hall of the forge city: a long forest-green wool dress with long sleeves and a wide embroidered hem band of small hammer shapes, a clean leather belt with a plain bronze buckle, the two braids freshly oiled and the stone rings polished, the stone bowl hung at the belt. She stands solid and straight with the hands folded in front, a quiet dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the camera slightly low, the amber eyes looking at the viewer with a calm, heavy kindness, the mouth closed. Warm orange furnace light from one side lighting the copper braids and the two faint scars. Foreground blur: drifting red sparks and the rim of a thick stone bowl. She wears the grey wool tunic and leather waistcoat.

name: 罗尔夫
src: 月银纪史诗/第八歌_未磨白骨.md:273
who: Rolf, a dwarf stonemason of the first forge line, forty-six and in a dwarf's prime: about 142 cm, short and tough, a slight stoop in the back, thick forearms from thirty years of chiselling. Sandy-gold beard braided into three strands, each tip weighed with a stone bead, with a fine film of stone dust that never brushes off. Thick bristly brows like two small brushes over small, bright eyes that look first at other people's hands. A straight nose, the corner of the mouth always pulled to one side as if he disapproves of something. A sharp-tongued, grumbling, caring air; he smiles by first curling his lip and then grinning.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf man's face in the prime of life, set and weathered, NOT a child's and NOT old: small bright dark-hazel eyes under thick bristly sandy brows; a straight nose; the mouth drawn a little to one side in a disapproving half-curl; the sandy-gold beard in three braids framing it; stone dust on the cheeks and in the beard. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
palette: sandy gold and stone grey, leather brown, chisel steel, dust white, a little deep blue
casual: His mason's clothes: a thick leather apron over a coarse grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, brown trousers and heavy boots; seven chisels of different sizes standing in the apron pocket, a small hammer hanging at the belt on the right hand side, a bundle slung on his back. A sour, sharp-eyed look.
private: Off work: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt hanging loose over plain trousers, the sleeves pushed up, felt slippers, the beard braids tucked over one shoulder. He holds a rough little stone cup in one hand, a grumbling half-smile.
battle: Not a fighter, ready to defend his bench: the leather apron cinched tight, leather forearm guards, iron-capped boots. He grips a heavy mason's hammer in his right hand and a short iron chisel in his left, held low in front of him; a stubborn scowling look.
battle_pose: 3) the work outfit: braced and stubborn, the shoulders set, the feet wide, the lip curled in a scowl, holding a mason's hammer in the right hand and a chisel in the left close to the body; he is not a fighter.
formal: Guest at the long hall of the forge city: a clean dark-blue wool tunic to the knees with a stitched hem band, a plain leather belt with a bronze buckle, the three beard braids oiled and freshly beaded, the apron left behind. He stands with the arms crossed over the chest, the lip still curled in a very slight smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the small bright eyes looking sideways at the viewer as if sizing up a rough stone, the corner of the mouth pulled up. Warm lamp light from one side lighting the stone dust on the sandy beard. Foreground blur: flying stone chips and the edge of a half-carved stone bowl. He wears the leather apron over the grey shirt.

name: 赫罗斯
src: 月银纪史诗/第八歌_未磨白骨.md:330
who: Heros, a blind old human singer of the grey-hill long hall, ninety-seven years old: about 175 cm, tall but thin, his back bowed with age. White hair hanging to the waist, loosely tied with a leather cord. Both eyes a clouded milky white, blind, yet always turned toward the fire. High cheekbones, a lean face worn by eighty years of wind like a smooth stone, still beautiful. Ten long slender fingers. A courteous, quiet, grave air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old man's face, lean and finely lined, with high cheekbones and hollow cheeks; eyes a clouded, milky white with no visible pupil; thin white eyebrows; a calm closed mouth; he is blind but the face is still handsome. Deep wrinkles across the brow and at the corners of the eyes.
build: 175 cm, tall and thin, a bowed back, long slender hands.
palette: faded deep blue, bone white, old wood brown, a little firelight orange
casual: His singer's robe: a long washed-out deep-blue robe to the ankles, loose sleeves, a plain rope belt, soft felt shoes. A thirteen-stringed lyre held against his chest in the crook of his left arm, unplayed, his right hand resting flat over the strings; at the belt a small leather pouch of thirteen stones. A quiet, listening look, the head tilted toward the fire.
private: Resting: the same faded blue robe loosened, a warm grey wool shawl over the shoulders, the white hair loose, a small leather pouch held in both hands as he feels the stones. A faint, tired smile.
battle: Not a fighter: a heavy dark-blue travelling cloak over the washed-out robe, a walking staff of pale ash wood in the right hand, the lyre on a strap across his back, the pouch of stones at the belt. He walks with the head raised toward a distant sound, a grave, unafraid look.
battle_pose: 3) the travelling outfit: standing upright and calm on a walking staff held in the right hand, the head raised and tilted a little to one side as if listening, the free left hand holding the strap of the lyre across his body; he is not a fighter.
formal: Singing at the long hall: a long indigo wool robe with a wide gold-thread band at the collar and hem, a plain silver clasp at the shoulder, the white hair combed and tied back with a new cord, the lyre held across his chest in both arms. He stands upright with his face lifted toward the fire, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the milky blind eyes open and turned a little toward the warm light at one side, the face calm and listening, the lips closed. Warm hearth light on the white hair and the high cheekbones. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the thin strings of the lyre. He wears the faded deep-blue robe.

name: 恩弗斯
src: 月银纪史诗/第八歌_未磨白骨.md:386
who: Enfus, a human young nobleman and the mouth of the grey-hill long hall, twenty-two: about 186 cm, tall, broad-shouldered, the throwing arm a size thicker than the other. Wheat-straw coloured hair cut at the jaw. Highland clear-sky blue eyes that look down first, half an inch, as if picking out the faults in people. A sharp, handsome, slightly cruel-looking face; a long claw scar on the jaw from the ear root down to the corner of the mouth (on the viewer's left when they face us), which he never covers. A proud, sharp-tongued, arrogant air. The claw scar is long and plainly drawn in every panel and in the portrait: a pale raking scar that starts at the root of his RIGHT ear and runs down along the jaw to the right corner of his mouth. His right side is the side on the viewer's LEFT when he faces us, so the scar sits in the LEFT half of the picture; the cheek and jaw in the right half of the picture are unmarked, and the scar is not hidden by hair.
build: 186 cm, tall and broad-shouldered, a straight back, the right arm noticeably thicker.
palette: wheat straw and highland blue, deep blue wool, black iron, a little bone white
casual: His long-hall clothes: a deep-blue wool over-robe of the grey hills with a black iron mountain-shaped clasp at the collar, a wide leather belt, dark trousers and leather boots, three twisted arm rings on his right upper arm (on the viewer's left when they face us). At the left hip a family longsword, its crossguard carved with the grey mountains. A cold, appraising look. The claw scar runs down the jaw in the LEFT half of the picture (his right jaw, on the viewer's left); the right half of the picture shows clear skin.
private: At ease in his rooms: the over-robe off, a long-sleeved deep-blue linen shirt with the collar open, dark trousers, soft boots, the arm rings still on. He holds a cup in one hand, a sour sideways look.
battle: Ready to throw: a hardened leather cuirass over the deep-blue tunic, leather bracers, a boiled-leather round shield painted with a mountain on the left arm. In his right hand a long ash-wood javelin drawn back over the shoulder, two more javelins held in a bundle in the shield hand, the sword sheathed at the left hip; a hard, scornful look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a throwing stance, the weight on the back leg, the right arm drawn back with a javelin at shoulder height, the left arm holding the round shield forward, the chin raised and the mouth closed in a scornful line.
formal: Speaking for the hall at the feast: a long deep-blue wool over-robe edged in black, the black iron mountain clasp polished, all three arm rings worn on the right upper arm, a belt of black iron plates, the family sword at the hip. He stands very straight with the chin raised, one hand on the sword hilt, a haughty look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the camera slightly low, the blue eyes looking down at the viewer with a bored, cutting look, one corner of the mouth lifted, the claw scar clear on the jaw. Warm red hearth light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the shaft of a javelin. He wears the deep-blue over-robe with the black iron clasp. The claw scar is on the jaw in the LEFT half of the picture (his right jaw, on the viewer's left), never on the right half.

name: 妮芙
src: 月银纪史诗/第八歌_未磨白骨.md:442
who: Nif, a human girl of seventeen, a young singer of the grey-hill long hall from the ore town of the wheat people: about 158 cm, a slender, light frame, her shoulders leaning slightly forward as if listening. Flax-coloured long hair in one thick braid, a single wheat straw tied to the end of it in the old custom of her people. Wheat-seedling green eyes, big and watchful, that look at people's mouths while they speak. A small face with a pointed chin. A low, soft-spoken, shy air that turns steady and sure the moment she sings.
palette: flax gold and seedling green, undyed linen, grey wool, a little gold thread
casual: Her travelling clothes: an undyed linen dress with long sleeves down to the shins, a grey wool shawl wrapped round the shoulders, over the dress a sleeveless vest with a single wheat ear embroidered in gold thread on the back between the shoulder blades; sturdy soft leather shoes and a small cloth bundle held in front. A shy, open, closed-mouth look.
private: Home in the evening: a long-sleeved, high-collared soft wool dress to the ankles in oatmeal, a knitted shawl, thick stockings and house shoes, the braid hanging over one shoulder. She holds a warm cup in both hands, a gentle closed-mouth smile.
battle: On the road in bad weather: a heavy grey wool travelling cloak with the hood up over the linen dress, the vest with the golden wheat ear on the back under it, leather gloves, laced boots, a walking stick in the right hand. A resolute, steady look, the brows drawn a little together, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: standing steady and resolute, the feet a little apart, both hands gripping a walking stick planted in front of her, the shoulders set, the brows drawn a little together and the mouth closed; she is not a fighter and holds no weapon.
formal: Singing for the hall: a long clean dress of flax-coloured linen with a wide band of small embroidered wheat ears at the hem and cuffs, a pale grey wool shawl pinned with a plain bronze pin, the braid freshly tied with a new straw. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the seedling-green eyes open and steady, looking straight at the viewer with a serious, earnest look, the mouth closed. Soft warm firelight from one side on the flax-coloured braid. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a single wheat straw. She wears the grey wool shawl over the linen dress.

name: 奥斯瓦尔德
src: 月银纪史诗/第八歌_未磨白骨.md:638
who: Oswald, the old king of the grey hills, a human of seventy-six: about 188 cm, tall, his back still straight. A white beard braided into two strands, long white hair, eyes the clear highland-sky blue of his dead son but clouded. A weathered, long, lined face; few words. On his head a heavy black iron circlet with three sockets for beast cores, the third socket empty. A generous, grave, tired air.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's long weathered face, deep lines across the brow and at the corners of the mouth; thin white eyebrows; pale clear-blue eyes slightly clouded; a straight nose; the white beard in two braids covering the chin. A grave closed mouth.
build: 188 cm, tall and big-framed, the back still straight, the shoulders a little thinner with age.
palette: highland blue and black iron, white hair, deep blue wool, a little dull gold
casual: His king's robe: a long deep-blue wool over-robe of the grey hills fastened at the collar with a black iron mountain-shaped clasp, a wide leather belt, dark trousers and old boots, one twisted bronze arm ring on the right forearm (on the viewer's left when they face us), and on his head the black iron circlet with three sockets, two of them set with a dim beast core and the third empty. A weary, grave look.
private: In his rooms: no circlet, the over-robe off, a long-sleeved, high-collared grey wool tunic to the knees, dark trousers, fur-lined house shoes, the white beard braids hanging forward. A grey wool blanket held round the shoulders with one hand, a faraway tired look.
battle: He does not take the field: a heavy dark-blue wool cloak over the over-robe, fastened with the black iron clasp, the circlet on his head, a plain straight staff of grey ash in the right hand with the iron-shod end on the ground, no weapon at his belt. A steady, heavy look.
battle_pose: 3) the cloaked outfit: standing tall and steady, both hands resting on the top of a plain ash staff planted in front of him, the chin level and the mouth closed in a grave line; he holds no weapon and does not fight.
formal: Opening the gates of the grey hills: a long deep-blue wool over-robe with a wide edging of black iron plates at the shoulders, the black iron circlet with its three sockets, the arm ring on the right forearm, a heavy blue cloak with an embroidered hem band of small mountain shapes. He stands upright with one hand raised to the clasp, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the clouded blue eyes looking at the viewer with a heavy, patient grief, the lips closed. Warm low hearth light from one side on the white beard braids and the black iron circlet with its empty third socket. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the edge of a long-hall table. He wears the deep-blue over-robe with the black iron clasp.
